title: cyclosorus triphyllus var. parishii
intro: Cyclosorus triphyllus var. parishii, commonly known as the Parish's Crested Lip Fern, is a type of plant belonging to the family Polypodiaceae, and is native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
